Callout.Name: Head Injury
Callout.Message: Person fallen and struck their head.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious but confused, bleeding from the scalp.

Script.Line: I do not remember anything after the kerb.
Somebody said I was out for a minute. I do not believe them.
I keep wanting to go to sleep. Tell me I can go to sleep.

Callout.Patient: I do not remember falling. Did I fall?

Lines.Approach: Head wounds bleed like nothing else and confuse afterwards. Watch the confusion, not the blood.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
